answer: An optoelectronic attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by reading speckle patterns generated when a violet laser shines through an onboard quartz resonator. Verifiers check interference fringes as optical power reaches a calibration summit to confirm a discrete physical host. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of provisioning separate photonic hardware per identity. However, thermal fluctuations distort speckle patterns, causing false rejections.
